answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 6028 Country: India Title: I have asked a question no is 5417 which i have got reply, but i wanted to tell that i person who is loking after work of masjid is not an employee of waqf commite .kindly answaer again question no 5417 is as fallows.... i am sameer deshmukh from gwalior,my matter is that there is a mosque in my neighbour where i offer namaz going regularly to masque i found that waqf commitie members has given permission to a non muslim to do all kind of work like wise collecting rent from shops of masque,giving sallary to imaam,cleaning water tank and other important work like mantaining all expenses records.but when i questioned to the waqf commitie they said there is no harm.and when i asked for expense statement they said you have no right to see the records we will show it to state waqf board and to allah only.please guid me from quran and hadit that such work of masjid be done by a non muslim or muslim ,and can a person see expense record of waqf commitie. Question: I have asked a question no is 5417 which i have got reply, but i wanted to tell that i person who is loking after work of masjid is not an employee of waqf commite .kindly answaer again question no 5417 is as fallows.... i am sameer deshmukh from gwalior,my matter is that there is a mosque in my neighbour where i offer namaz going regularly to masque i found that waqf commitie members has given permission to a non muslim to do all kind of work like wise collecting rent from shops of masque,giving sallary to imaam,cleaning water tank and other important work like mantaining all expenses records.but when i questioned to the waqf commitie they said there is no harm.and when i asked for expense statement they said you have no right to see the records we will show it to state waqf board and to allah only.please guid me from quran and hadit that such work of masjid be done by a non muslim or muslim ,and can a person see expense record of waqf commitie. Answer ID: 6028 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1258/1063=B -1429) The unrelated person has no right to investigate the expense details of the committee, the reply given by the Waqf Committee is correct. It is allowable if they get the outside work of the mosque done by a non-Muslim, albeit it is better that all the employees of the Waqf Committee are Muslims. The previous reply given by us is absolutely right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
